summary: BTQ Technologies Corp. filed a Form 6-K with a news release dated August 7, 2026, announcing the completion of the first technical milestone in its multi-year collaboration with ITRI to validate its Quantum Compute-in-Memory (QCIM) architecture for post-quantum cryptography. The milestone validated the QCIM core IP within a TSMC 28-nanometre design environment, demonstrating acceleration of cryptographic operations for NIST FIPS 203, 204 and 205 standards. The collaboration is part of a global QCIM chip roadmap led by BTQ and ICTK. No financial terms, transactions, or special-situation events are disclosed; this is a routine operational progress announcement.
